description: KiwiRail publishes recognised public and private level-crossing points. Metadata fields include line, kilometre reference, crossing type, control, status and crossing name. Private crossings are not fully identified or documented. Points show the general vicinity of a crossing and do not locate a precise structure or boundary. These asset locations and control attributes can support rail-road interface studies, subject to those completeness and positional limits. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
